        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int array[] = new int[n];
        int cost[] = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(cost, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            array[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int co = 0, ce = 0, cut = 0, coin = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (array[i] % 2 == 0) {
                ce += 1;
            } else {
                co += 1;
            }
            if (co == ce && i != array.length - 1) {
                if (i != (array.length - 1)) {
                    cost[i] = Math.abs(array[i + 1] - array[i]);
                }
                co = 0;
                ce = 0;
            }
        }
        Arrays.sort(cost);
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < cost.length; i++) {
            if (cost[i] != -1) {
                sum = sum + cost[i];
                if (sum > b) {
                    break;
                }
                cut += 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(cut);
    }
}
